name: Siófok (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Siófok: a blue shield with a yellow ship's wheel and a white flag, within a wreath of grain, on a green base.
history: The present flag of Siófok dates from 1991, replacing the flag used from 1974. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
